why_this_data.value: Nearly face-on geometry allows direct imaging of radial structure

evidence.quote: G353 is the best target for direct imaging of any radial structures in the disk

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Tidal perturbation by a cluster member rejected since no bright member in FOV

limitations_admitted.value: Beta uncertainty dominates Q; kinematic model not finely fitted; larger-scale envelope resolved out

evidence.quote: The major uncertainty of $Q$ in this study originates from the uncertainty of the dust opacity index $\beta$
